name: Studio 49 Photography
tagline: Every Moment, Perfectly Framed in Bend
brandNarrative:
Studio 49 Photography operates out of Bend, Oregon — a landscape so naturally dramatic that rainbows span entire mountain valleys and pine-lined roads beg to be photographed. Customers like Michael Womack have called the studio 'very nice and knowledgeable,' pointing to an operation that leads with genuine expertise rather than salesmanship. The word 'interesting' from reviewer Mitch Estrada suggests a creative sensibility that doesn't play it safe — this isn't a cookie-cutter portrait mill, it's a studio with a distinct point of view.

With a 4-star rating across 13 reviews, Studio 49 has built a quiet but loyal following in Central Oregon. The clientele is eclectic — one reviewer simply wrote 'Naked Winery,' hinting at a fun, adventurous spirit that extends to the kinds of shoots and collaborations the studio takes on. This is a photographer who is comfortable in unpredictable, lively environments and brings genuine warmth to every session.

Based out of a residential address in Bend's 97702 zip code, Studio 49 keeps overhead lean and attention focused squarely on the work. The surrounding region — with its mountains, forests, rivers, and small-town character — provides an endless natural canvas. Whether documenting a local business, capturing a family milestone, or shooting commercial product work, Studio 49 brings a knowledgeable, personable approach that clients notice and remember.
ownerStory:
The photographer behind Studio 49 chose Bend, Oregon for a reason — few places in the American West offer such relentless visual beauty, from storm-lit mountain passes to the quiet drama of high desert light. Operating a lean, focused studio out of Reed Lane, they've built their reputation not through flashy marketing but through the kind of quiet competence that makes clients say 'very nice and knowledgeable' after a session. They show up prepared, they know their craft, and they make the experience feel easy.

What sets Studio 49 apart is range without pretension. A glance at the work suggests a photographer who has shot winery events, construction company signage, sporting goods retail displays, local landmarks, and sweeping Oregon landscapes — all with the same steady eye. That versatility, combined with an approachable personality that puts even first-time clients at ease, is the real product. In a region full of stunning scenery and creative people, Studio 49 has found its niche by being genuinely good at a lot of things and genuinely enjoyable to work with.

faq.question: What makes Studio 49 different from other photographers in Bend?
faq.answer: Customers specifically call out the photographer's knowledge and approachability — you're working with someone who understands their craft deeply and makes the experience feel comfortable and unhurried. Studio 49 also has a genuinely broad range, shooting everything from winery events to commercial business imagery.

faq.question: What types of sessions and shoots does Studio 49 take on?
faq.answer: Studio 49 has a wide portfolio that includes portraits, commercial business photography, event coverage, product and retail photography, and sweeping Oregon landscape work. If you have a creative or commercial need, it's worth reaching out to discuss your project.

faq.question: Is Studio 49 available for business and commercial clients?
faq.answer: Yes. The studio's portfolio includes work for construction companies, retail sporting goods stores, apartment complexes, and restaurants — indicating strong experience with commercial and brand photography for local Oregon businesses.

faq.question: Where is Studio 49 located and do they travel for shoots?
faq.answer: Studio 49 is based at 20240 Reed Ln, Bend, OR 97702. Given the nature of the photography portfolio — which includes outdoor landscapes, business exteriors, and event coverage — on-location shoots throughout Central Oregon are very much part of what they do.

faq.question: How do I book a session or get a quote?
faq.answer: The best way to reach Studio 49 is by phone at (541) 331-6494. There is currently no website, so a direct call is the fastest way to discuss your project, check availability, and get pricing information.

faq.question: What is the general pricing and are sessions affordable?
faq.answer: Studio 49 operates as a lean, independent studio in Bend — which typically means more competitive, flexible pricing compared to larger commercial studios. Contact them directly at (541) 331-6494 to discuss your specific needs and get a tailored quote.
